descriptionChirho: Intransitive physical dripping or dropping of liquid, used of rain, myrrh, honeycomb, or other substances falling in drops.
Metaphorical use in the Hifil stem meaning to let words drop or flow forth, i.e., to prophesy or preach, often with negative connotations of unauthorized or unwanted prophetic speech.
Causative Hifil use retaining the literal physical sense of causing liquid to drip or flow, as in mountains dripping sweet wine in eschatological abundance.
